assertions.assertion: Explains the library registers IConfigureNamedOptions<OpenIdConnectOptions> wrapping OnRedirectToIdentityProvider, OnAuthorizationCodeReceived, OnTokenValidated and OnPushAuthorization
assertions.rationale: Explains the IConfigureNamedOptions<OpenIdConnectOptions> wrapping and tabulates OnRedirectToIdentityProvider, OnAuthorizationCodeReceived, OnTokenValidated and OnPushAuthorization.

assertions.assertion: States assigning new event handlers/OpenIdConnectEvents replaces the DPoP handlers; capture the existing handler and invoke it from yours
assertions.rationale: States replacing options.Events/handlers discards library handlers; shows capturing originalRedirect/originalPush and invoking them.

assertions.assertion: States OpenIdConnectOptions.EventsType must not be used because it silently removes all library handlers
assertions.rationale: States setting EventsType silently removes all library handlers.

assertions.assertion: With PAR, signs the request in OnPushAuthorization before invoking the library handler (so dpop_jkt is included in the signed request and the client assertion is added afterwards); without PAR signs in OnRedirectToIdentityProvider after the library handler
assertions.rationale: Signs in OnPushAuthorization before calling originalPush, and wraps OnRedirectToIdentityProvider calling library first when PAR is not used.

assertions.assertion: Notes the library adds the client assertion from IClientAssertionService to the code exchange and, on .NET 9+, the PAR request, but does not create JAR request objects
assertions.rationale: States the library adds the client assertion to the code exchange and PAR (.NET 9+) but does not create JAR request objects.
